defs.def: not supporting or helping either side in a disagreement, competition, etc. 中立的；持平的；无倾向性的
not belonging to any of the countries that are involved in a war; not supporting any of the countries involved in a war 中立国的；中立的
deliberately not expressing any strong feeling 中性的；不含褒贬义的

ex.s: As a major breakthrough for China in the field of astronomy, its key functions are to survey neutral hydrogen in space, observe pulsars and track and communicate with spacecraft.
ex.t: 作为中国在天文学领域的重大突破，它的关键功能是勘测太空中的中性氢、观测脉冲星以及与航天器进行跟踪和通信。

defs.def: not very bright or strong, such as grey or light brown 素净的；淡素的；不鲜艳的
neither acid nor alkaline 中性的；非酸性又非碱性的
having neither a positive nor a negative electrical charge 中性的；不带电的
the position of the gears of a vehicle in which no power is carried from the engine to the wheels （汽车排挡）空挡
a person or country that does not support either side in a disagreement, competition or war 中立者；中立国
a colour that is not bright or strong, such as grey or light brown 素净色；中和色
